name: MiniMax Music 3 · local ComfyUI
description: Open-model workflow adapter. Requires an installed compatible ComfyUI workflow; the model card currently requires CUDA, so this is not a native Mac GPU option. Check the model licence before use.

name: MiniMax Music 3.0 · existing API accounts
description: Chinese music model with vocals or instrumentals. MiniMax closed music API access to new customers on August 20, 2026; existing paying accounts only. Requested duration is prompt guidance.

name: MiniMax Hailuo 3 · via Runway
description: Chinese hosted video model, using Runway credits. Local open-weight checkpoints require their own compatible workflow and licence review.

name: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 · via Runway
description: Chinese hosted video model. Runway credits; not an open-source or local model.

name: Alibaba Wan 3 · via Runway
description: Chinese hosted video model. Runway credits; separate from the downloadable Wan 2.2 models.

name: Wan 2.2 / local video · ComfyUI
description: Local workflow adapter for open-weight video models. Bring an installed ComfyUI workflow and suitable GPU; Wan 2.2 uses Apache-2.0. No model weights are bundled.

name: ACE-Step / local music · ComfyUI
description: Local workflow adapter for open-weight music generation. ACE-Step code and weights are Apache-2.0; other workflow checkpoints have their own licences.

name: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1
description: Cinematic shots and prompt-driven visual storytelling. Duration is a request.

name: Runway Gen-4.5
description: 2–10 second shots, queued generation with resumable task IDs.

name: Veo 3.1 · via Runway
description: 4, 6 or 8 second cinematic shots. Uses your Runway API account.

name: Lyria 3.5
description: Original songs with lyrics and vocals, or instrumental ideas. Up to about 3 minutes; prompt timing is approximate.

name: ElevenLabs stem separation
description: Upload a song and receive separate audio tracks. Provider charges apply; identify the guitar track before using minus-guitar.

name: Eleven Music
description: Prompt-to-song generation with a requested duration and an instrumental switch.
